applied.description: Whether the policy was applied to the particular target or request being described; this is an observation, not an enablement flag.

document.description: Policy document or source details serialized as JSON; retain the original structure.

policy-id.description: Source identifier of this policy instance.

type.description: Policy kind, such as Identity Policy, Resource Policy, or Service Control Policy.

description: A security policy instance and its observed application state, including an optional policy document. Suitable for identity, resource and organizational guardrail policies. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/policy.
name: security-policy
